// diagnostic

E0927

`#{name}` isn't a known applied rule

What

`#{name}` isn't a known applied rule

Why

Applied rules come from the marker registry and the marker declarations in scope.

Fix

Use a registered rule name, or declare the marker.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0927: tests/ui/E0927_allow_marker_legal.stderr.

Error [jet.UnknownAppliedRule]: `#Bogus` isn't a known applied rule
  --> tests/ui/E0927_allow_marker_legal.jet:10:2
    |
 10 | #Bogus
    |  ^^^^^
 Why: `Bogus` isn't registered as an applied rule — Jet rules are a closed, registered vocabulary, not any PascalCase word.
 Fix: Check the spelling, or see Docs/spec/syntax-decisions.md for the full applied-rule list.
